description: Product scored on the frozen held-out set (10-DECISION 8; decision 2026-10-01-tools-shape item 7, the untemplated held-out pass rate; ENG-12). The one baseline scorer (scripts/eval_dev_baseline.py, split held_out) loads the set eval.heldout froze (run id heldout-v2, in the host state directory) only through evals.runner's held-out load: the credentialed environment, PLX_EVAL_HELD_OUT_DIR outside Git holding that state directory, every item schema-valid and none sharing a document, root or identifier with a committed dev or exposed item. It refuses (exit 3, refused a code) a set that is not frozen, differs from its digest list or was frozen from another source, or shares a partition key with a live dev run's manifest. The standard items run on the deterministic investigation path over the runner session's mirror and projection (as eval.dev_baseline); each metamorphic variant runs on that run's own mirror replayed perturbed as the item records (the oracle's own transform, evals/oracle/perturb.py portal_port, through the GET-only client into a mirror and projection of its own, its clock moved with the replica time): one perturbed product per perturbation, never a second read of any source. Only the Portal is perturbed, so a variant whose label reads BC or a document is refused by admission (perturbed_reads_not_served), counted in admission_refused. Run pins read no oracle: each checks the frozen label's value against the pinned mirror row (pin_drift when the source has since moved). stdout: eval.held_out (the pass rate), eval.by_family, eval.by_variant, eval.answer, counts and the set hash; aggregates and codes only, never an item id, a value, a label or a per-item row.
notes: live-unverified until a passing live-check result; the keyless counterpart is the fixture held-out set (python3 -m scripts.eval_oracle_dev heldout --source fixture, then python3 -m scripts.eval_dev_baseline heldout --source fixture under a held-out directory; tests/test_eval_dev_baseline.py HeldOutProductTests). Daily and bounded: no oracle generation (the set is frozen), so the run spends its 1800 s budget on the product: the session mirror and projection (or its own build, which stops 600 s before the end), the standard items, then one perturbed product per variant group, the transforms in turn, each a delta over the base product (a copy of its mirror with only the relations the perturbation touches replayed, projected incrementally over the base generation, so only those relations' units rebuild); the 2400 s timeout leaves the watchdog its 60 s grace. eval.heldout measured 699 s (heldout-v1), 2008 s and 1878 s (heldout-v2 generations, 2026-10-11/12): this check reads no source of its own and runs inside one such budget. A group the budget does not reach is counted in variant_products not_reached and leaves eval.complete false (exit 3): measured, never assumed. Skipped until the credentialed environment sets PLX_EVAL_HELD_OUT_DIR to a directory outside Git holding the held-out state directory (the default $PLX_EVAL_HELDOUT_DIR or $XDG_STATE_HOME/plx-workbench/eval-heldout). Requires eval.heldout: no frozen set until it passes once (heldout-v2 has not frozen yet: its fresh generations were 239/240 deterministic); a missing set is refused heldout_set_not_frozen. Known limits: a repeated_event variant whose cited row is delivered twice cannot be pinned (the runner's run pin reads key_not_unique: pin_drift, excluded from every rate); variants reading BC or documents are not scored (admission_refused perturbed_reads_not_served); the deterministic path still counts plan-less families needs_agent. B1: the check passes only when eval.answer meets accuracy_rate (correct/answered) >= 0.8, coverage_rate (answered/ran) >= 0.8 and confident_unsupported_rate (over answered) <= 0.02 (scripts.eval_dev_baseline answer_block via evals.score.answer_rates); a Portal-outage run is judged on the items that ran with the same rates.
